HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

4. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

4. D — Producers

6. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. A — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

8. C — 100 °C

9. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
